result.summary: On 3 July an invoice email came in under the name Cedar Solutions. The contractor on this job is Stonebridge Works, and the visit isn't until 8 July 2024. I can't see the invoice itself, so the amount is unknown. I've passed the invoice check to the operations team so nothing gets paid, asked Stonebridge Works to explain the name and send the invoice, told the landlord, and set a 2-day follow-up.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord approved a contractor visit (ev 9), then replied 'Yes please proceed' (ev 21) to a quote of £35+VAT for a handle or £90+VAT for a lock. Stonebridge Works (Miles) booked 8 July (ev 26, 28-30). The invoice email (ev 32) is under a different company name, arrived before the booked visit, and has no visible document or amount. The payee can't be matched to the contractor, so the rules say don't pay and escalate. The classifier also said 'review' (needs_human_response 0.84).

alternatives_considered.option: Treat Cedar Solutions as a trading name and process the invoice
alternatives_considered.why_not: No amount or document is visible, the payee doesn't match, and the invoice arrived before the visit. Paying would risk the landlord's money on an invoice we can't check.

alternatives_considered.option: No action and wait for the 8 July visit
alternatives_considered.why_not: An invoice asking for prompt payment is sitting unprocessed, and someone needs to check it so it isn't paid by mistake.
Nothing shows the work has been done. The visit is still booked for 8 July.
